title: 第23章 HelloKittyV第24章 色即是空
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
“当然了，难不成你以为我一直在跟你开玩笑？”
他们各论各的嘛。
他叫她小师妹，她在心里叫他爹。
完全没毛病。
宁雄霸满头黑线，“楚楚，你当真想清楚了？”
“老夫是看你根骨奇佳才想收你为徒，你倒好，还得寸进尺起来了？”
“想拜老夫的师尊为师，你看天罚劈不劈死你。”
话音刚落，两人头上登时响起滚雷声。
他下意识捂住嘴，诧异地抬头看向快速聚拢的乌云：“**，老子的嘴什么时候变得这么灵了？”
说罢忙闭上眼睛双手作揖，小声嘀咕道：“师尊您老人家在上，可看清楚一点，别劈错人了。”
宁楚也抬头看，听见雷声她就想到那跟随了她一百八十八年的乌云，气不打一处来。
单手叉腰，另一手指天，雄赳赳气昂昂地仰天大骂：“你劈什么劈？你看清楚了吗就劈？”
“众生平等，你姑奶奶我想拜谁为师就拜谁为师，什么时候轮到你来管了？你哪位啊？”
“姑奶奶我不发威，你当我是hellokittyv是吧？”
乌云翻滚两圈，闪电炸响，然后当着四人的面缓缓散去，天空重新恢复晴朗。
宁雄霸和厚朴惊得目瞪口呆，厚朴指尖捏着的药丸啪嗒一声掉在地上，他的白胡子一抖一抖的，指着宁楚，“这……这这这……”
敢跟天道叫板？
这也太厉害了！
思及此，他瞬间站直身体，拍了拍手，踱步到宁楚面前，故作高深地捋了捋胡子，“这位道友，老夫观你与药峰有缘？可想拜入我药峰门下？”
“只要你拜入我的门下，药峰所有灵丹妙药，天材地宝随你取用。”

“你考虑考虑，如何？”
宁雄霸：“你想都不要想！”
“楚楚啊，拜我，不，拜我师尊为师。”他搓着手，笑得一脸谄媚，“老夫现在就回去请香，上报师尊，然后就由我来代替他老人家收你为徒。”
“我是天剑宗宗主，你当了我的小师妹，想要什么没有？拜我拜我。”
“我呸！”厚朴啐他一口，翻了个白眼道：“你全副身家一半给了宁楚，一半给了宝儿，剩下的全给宁楚盖坟了。”
“整个天剑宗上下谁不知道你这个宗主是最穷的！选我药峰，有前途！”
“我没有，我徒弟有，我徒孙有，我小师弟也有。我有人脉有手段，你一个长老拿什么跟我比？”
宁雄霸比了个请的手势：“看完病了吗？看完了就请你自己滚，别耽误我跟我小师妹培养感情，谢谢。”
厚朴被他气得吹胡子瞪眼：“你你你……”
宁楚站在两人中间一脸懵。
刚才不是还不要吗？现在怎么又两边都开始抢了？
这对吗？
正在此时，一直在旁边没说话的鹤隐舟上前一步拦在宁楚面前，对另外两人说：“拜师一事马虎不得。”
“她到底适合拜在谁门下，由我先考较一番再行确定为好。”
宁雄霸一听，满口答应下来。
厚朴眯着眼睛觑他，半信半疑道：“隐鹤仙尊，你不会是想跟我们俩抢人才这么说的吧？”
“不能不能不能。”宁雄霸连连摆手，“小师弟不是这样的人。”
“他曾当着我的面发过誓，此生只有宁楚一个徒弟，绝对不会再收别人为徒。”
content_en:
"Of course, do you think I've been joking with you?"
They all talk about their own affairs.
He called her little junior sister, and she called him daddy in her heart.
Nothing wrong with it at all.
Ning Xiongba's head was full of black lines, "Chu Chu, have you really thought about it clearly?"
"I want to accept you as my disciple because of your extraordinary talent. How about you? Are you going to push yourself further?"
"If you want to take me as your master, you will see if God's punishment will kill you."
As soon as they finished speaking, the sound of rolling thunder suddenly sounded above the two of them.
He subconsciously covered his mouth and looked up in surprise at the rapidly gathering dark clouds: "**, when did my mouth become so smart?"
After saying that, he quickly closed his eyes, bowed his hands, and murmured in a low voice: "Master, I'm here, please see clearly and don't hit the wrong person."
Ning Chu also looked up. When she heard the thunder, she thought of the dark clouds that had followed her for one hundred and eighty-eight years, and she became very angry.
With one hand on his hips and the other pointing to the sky, he looked up to the sky and cursed majestically: "What are you doing to chop? Do you chop if you see clearly?"
"All living beings are equal. Your aunt, I can take as my teacher whomever I want. When will it be your turn to take charge? Who are you?"
"Auntie, if I don't show off my power, you think I'm hellokittyv, right?"
The dark clouds rolled twice, lightning exploded, and then slowly dispersed in front of the four people, and the sky became clear again.
Ning Xiongba and Houpu were stunned. The pills held by Houpu's fingertips fell to the ground with a clatter. His white beard trembled and he pointed at Ning Chu, "This...this, this, this..."
Dare to challenge Tiandao?
This is amazing!
Thinking of this, he stood up straight in an instant, clapped his hands, walked up to Ning Chu, and stroked his beard in a pretentious manner, "Fellow Taoist, I think you are destined to be with Yaofeng? Do you want to become my disciple?"
"As long as you become my disciple, all the miraculous elixirs, materials and treasures of Yaofeng will be at your disposal."
"How about you think about it?"
Ning Xiongba: "Don't even think about it!"
"Chu Chu, please worship me, no, worship my master as your teacher." He rubbed his hands and smiled flatteringly, "I will go back now to offer incense and report it to the master, and then I will accept you as his disciple on his behalf."
"I am the leader of the Tianjian Sect. You have become my junior sister. What do you want? Be my worshiper."
"Bah!" Houpu spat at him, rolled his eyes and said, "Half of your wealth was given to Ning Chu, half to Bao'er, and the rest was used to build Ning Chu's grave."
"Who in the entire Tianjian Sect doesn't know that you, the sect leader, are the poorest! Choose me, Yaofeng, and you have a bright future!"
"I don't have it. My disciples have it, my disciples have it, and my junior brother has it. I have connections and means. How can you, an elder, compare to me?"
Ning Xiongba made a gesture of invitation: "Have you finished watching the disease? Please go away after you finish watching. Don't delay my relationship with my little junior sister. Thank you."
Houpu was so angry that he blew his beard and stared: "You, you, you..."
Ning Chu stood between the two of them, looking confused.
Didn’t you just want it? Why are both sides starting to grab it now?
Is this right?
At this moment, He Yinzhou, who had been silent next to him, stepped forward and stopped in front of Ning Chu, and said to the other two people: "You can't be careless about becoming a disciple."
"Which one is suitable for her to be a disciple of? It's better for me to test it out first and then decide."
Upon hearing this, Ning Xiongba agreed.
Houpu squinted his eyes and looked at him, and said dubiously: "Xianzun Yinhe, you are not saying this because you want to compete with us for talents, are you?"
"No, no, no." Ning Xiongba waved his hands repeatedly, "Junior brother is not such a person."
"He once swore in front of me that he would only have one disciple, Ning Chu, in this life, and he would never accept anyone else as his disciple."
